messages:
maria: quick UX check — put a tiny prototype up (figma + staging). Two questions: should the primary streaming control read 'Pause generation' (resumable) or 'Stop generation' (final)? And token counter: inline under the streaming message or top-right global header? figma: https://figma.com/proto/stream-ux :eyes:

devin: my vote: inline primary near the stream, label it 'Pause generation' to reduce anxiety. expose 'Stop' in overflow for hard cancel. add aria-pressed and aria-busy states.

sam: inline counter under each message for context. collapse exact numbers by default (show estimate e.g. "~42") and reveal exact on hover/focus. tooltip: "Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)".

elaine: accessibility: set aria-live="polite" on the streaming container and aria-busy while streaming. Announce state changes via an offscreen status node ("Generation paused", "Generation resumed"). Ensure Resume gets focus when paused.

zoe: microcopy note: use "Pause generation (Esc)" as the button tooltip to communicate keyboard shortcut. When paused show a small inline badge: "Paused — resume to continue" + actions Resume / Stop and a hint that closing the tab discards the session.

maria: agreed. proposal: primary = Pause (inline), Stop hidden in overflow; token counter inline collapsed with hover/focus reveal. I'll upload two figma variants (Pause-primary vs Stop-primary) and run a 5-person quick test.

preview-bot: staging preview: https://playground.staging.redwood/preview/stream-ux-186 (expires in 72h)

maria: action items: @devin wire aria-live/aria-busy and offscreen announcements in prototype; @sam implement inline collapsed counter + tooltip; @elaine add keyboard focus rules and keybindings to a11y doc; @zoe write paused badge copy. thanks! :thumbsup:
